The Xcode project is generated from project.yml (xcodegen at the repo root) and is not committed.  Version numbering (HH-191, owner directive 2026-10-26):  ONE NUMBER, and it is a version string -- MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION carry the same string (0.1.1 (0.1.1)).  The number is one past what the 0.1 train already holds (the committed record in project.yml, plus what App Store Connect holds, drift trains ignored);  the commit-count build number and UTC build stamps are retired.
